note: Motley County (48345) has no public queryable tax parcel service found. The statewide TxGIO/CAD Texas Land Parcels layer (services2 kaw106_shsu) returns query errors for FIPS 48345 (same error as a nonexistent FIPS, unlike Cottle 48101 which returns features) and timed out on validation; the statewide Parcel_Boundaries layer has no Motley rows; the county ArcGIS web map service has only polling places, addresses, county outline and precincts, no parcels. Motley CAD is website-only (Pro-subscription map viewer); parcel data is sold via vendors (Dynamo, Regrid, texascountygisdata).
